reel.linkedin:
A question I get from first-time silver buyers: how do I know if a dealer's price is fair?

The answer is one calculation: take the all-in price (including shipping), divide by troy ounces, subtract spot. That's your premium percentage.

Generic rounds typically run 5-8% over spot. American Silver Eagles run 15-22%. Ten-ounce bars run 3-6%.

Get three quotes on the same day, use the same spot price, run the formula on each. The rest is easy comparison.
